agreement: Cohen's kappa on each axis over the 40-source set. Both rating sheets are committed. Perfect kappa on both axes is suspicious given planted borderline rows.

levels.MAINTAINER: Official documentation, README, changelog, or contributing guide published by the project that owns the thing.
levels.PRACTITIONER: First-hand observation: measurement, reproduction, incident, or operator notes that add a local experiment.
levels.PRIMARY: The artifact is the thing itself: RFC/PEP/schema/license text, or the implementing source file.
levels.RETELLER: News, tutorial, newsletter, or Q&A that restates another source without adding observation.

authority.question: Is this the thing itself, a maintainer, a practitioner, or a re-teller?
authority.rule: Assign the highest level whose definition matches. Fail closed to RETELLER.

levels.DERIVED: Cites, paraphrases, or transforms another source without new observation.
levels.ORIGINATING: Adds observation not present in other members of the scored set.
levels.PARALLEL: Independent observation of the same phenomenon as another originating source (shared topic, distinct body).
levels.SYNDICATED: Verbatim or near-verbatim copy of another source in the set. This is the low-independence bucket.

independence.question: Does this add observation, or restate another source?
independence.rule: Assign the lowest independence that matches. Five identical bodies at five URLs are five SYNDICATED rows, not five votes.

protocol: Publish this document and its sha256 BEFORE scoring the 40-source set. Authority and independence are scored on separate axes. A primary source that is a syndicated reprint is still PRIMARY on authority and SYNDICATED (low) on independence. The axes must not be collapsed into a single 'quality' number.

A.features: URL host/path class and exact-body sha256 clustering only

B.features: body markers and pairwise word 5-gram Jaccard; URL is sealed

title: Authority x independence source-quality rubric
